definitions.gloss: to muster, to summon, to squeeze out
definitions.explanation: To gather every last bit of one's courage, strength, or voice through great effort. Implies pushing oneself to the limit to produce something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{絞|しぼ}る。
⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{絞|しぼ}って⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I squeezed out every last ounce of strength and crossed the finish line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{絞|しぼ}って⟦{助|たす}け→助け：07777_tasuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: I summoned all my voice to call for help.

notes:
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}), る-ending (godan, not ichidan).
- Negative: {振|ふ}り{絞|しぼ}らない
- Polite: {振|ふ}り{絞|しぼ}ります
- Te-form: {振|ふ}り{絞|しぼ}って
- Past: {振|ふ}り{絞|しぼ}った

USAGE:
Almost always used with abstract objects like ⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧ (courage), ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧ (strength), or ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ (voice). The expression conveys a sense of desperation or maximum effort — reaching deep inside oneself for reserves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{絞|しぼ}る: to summon one's courage
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{絞|しぼ}る: to muster all one's strength
- ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{絞|しぼ}る: to squeeze out one's voice
- ⟦{知恵|ちえ}→知恵：03428_chie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{絞|しぼ}る: to rack one's brains
